info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Lookup API enables seamless access to banking contact information across various channels based on a specified parameter. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed contact data associated with a particular identifier, enhancing communication and customer support efforts. It is particularly useful for banking institutions looking to streamline interactions and provide comprehensive support to their clients. Key consumers include customer service representatives and business analysts who require quick access to relevant contact details for effective client management.
